name: Tonight Is The Night
source:
Explore the captivating world of "Tonight Is The Night," an adult visual novel where you play as an 18-year-old protagonist. After finishing high school, you spend the summer at your family friends' place. As you reconnect with your mysterious landlady, an irresistible desire begins to  stir within you. Navigate a web of complex relationships, make crucial choices, and discover the blurred lines between temptation and love in this unforgettable tale of passion and forbidden desires.

[From [url=https://randomaccessmemories.itch.io/tonightisthenight]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
探索《Tonight Is The Night》的迷人世界。在这部成人视觉小说中，你将扮演一位18岁的主人公。高中毕业后，你到世交家度过暑假。与神秘的女房东重逢之际，一股无法抗拒的欲望在你心中悄然苏醒。在这段关于激情与禁忌欲望的难忘故事里，穿行于错综复杂的人际关系，作出关键选择，探索诱惑与爱情之间模糊的界线。

[摘自[url=https://randomaccessmemories.itch.io/tonightisthenight]itch.io[/url]]
